title: Indie Developer Pricing Strategy
summary: Pricing strategies for solo developer VST plugins targeting consumer budgets.
description:
## Key Pricing Principles

### Lifetime vs Subscription

| Model | Conversion Rate | When to Use |
|-------|-----------------|-------------|
| **Lifetime** | 3x higher | Products running locally (most plugins) |
| **Subscription** | Lower | Only with ongoing server/API costs |

### Psychological Pricing

| Price Point | Notes |
|-------------|-------|
| $29 | Particularly effective entry point |
| $49 | Converts better than $51 |
| $99 | Key threshold, signals quality |
| Round numbers | Signal confidence, avoid .99 |

### Price Anchoring

- Create product lineup with deliberate price points
- Keep products at least 40% apart in price
- Entry-level price acts as "why not" purchase

### Value-Based Pricing

- Price based on outcome/time saved, not development effort
- Consider what the problem costs the buyer to solve manually

## Marketplace Commissions

| Channel | Commission | Notes |
|---------|------------|-------|
| Own website | 3-5% | Payment processing only |
| KVR DIRECT | 0% | No seller fees |
| Plugin Boutique | 15-30% | Built-in audience |
| Multi-channel | Varies | Most successful approach |

## Recommended Strategy

1. Build own website for brand control and highest margins
2. List on marketplaces for visibility
3. Use free tools/products as funnels to paid offerings
4. Consider geographic pricing parity

## Capital Constraint

Target: Under $500 total capital investment (excluding Claude subscription)

| Expense | Cost Range |
|---------|------------|
| Claude subscription | $100-200/month |
| Licensing system | $5,000/year (PACE) or free alternatives |
| Website hosting | $10-50/month |
| Marketing | $0-200/month |

For sub-$75K revenue: PACE Indie Program offers up to $3,000 savings.
